# Live Swap and Rollback Checklist: Make www.doncoleman.ca the main address

**Purpose**: Validate that the dashboard swap, check and rollback requirements are complete, ordered and recoverable.
**Created**: 2026-10-10
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md), [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist`. Items test the quality of the written requirements, not the implementation.

## Swap Sequence

- [ ] CHK001 Is each swap step stated with a precondition, an observable completion signal and a time bound? [Measurability, Spec §US4.1]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the step order consistent between the Clarifications, US4.1, the Edge Cases downtime entry and the runbook contract? [Consistency, Spec §US4]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the expected outage per host (minutes) quantified for the `www` gap and the bare-domain gap? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK004 Is it specified what to do if `www` certificate issuance does not finish within a stated time? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK005 Are the exact Cloudflare objects to remove (rule name, record type and name for the old `www`) identified unambiguously, including any record the Custom Domain left behind? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the redirect rule's expression and target specified precisely enough to reproduce (host match, scheme, status 301, preserve query, dynamic path)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the interaction between Always Use HTTPS, the redirect rule and rule ordering specified, rather than left as "may run first"? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the placeholder record's choice (`AAAA 100::`, proxied) justified against an `A 192.0.2.1` alternative and consistent across FR-007, FR-010, Key Entities and the baseline contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the SC-004 30-minute budget broken down so each step's share is plausible, and does it include certificate wait? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]

## Rollback and Recovery

- [ ] CHK010 Are rollback steps defined for every partial state (after step 2, after 3, after 4, after 5), not only a generic "restore"? [Coverage, Spec §US4.2]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the rollback order explicit about removing the bare-domain redirect and placeholder before re-attaching the bare Custom Domain (DNS record conflict)? [Gap, Spec §US4.2]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the point of no return (if any) identified, e.g. after the sitemap resubmission? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the 24-hour retry window and revert-PR fallback specified with an owner and a trigger, and consistent with the same-day merge-to-swap expectation? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the state of the deployed build after a rollback (names `www`, served on bare) specified as acceptable for the retry window, with its SEO consequence? [Edge Case, Spec §US4.2]
- [ ] CHK015 Are requirements stated for the setup check's expected results after a rollback (which items fail, with what next step)? [Coverage, Gap]

## Setup Check Requirements

- [ ] CHK016 Is each "Live hosts" failure class (old arrangement, half-switched, 302, dropped query, extra hop, loop, TLS failure) mapped to a distinct result and next step? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the distinction between `pending`, `missing` and `could-not-check` defined in the spec, not only the plan? [Gap, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK018 Are probe timeouts, retries and tolerance for transient network failure specified so a flaky probe is not reported as a misconfiguration? [Gap, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the DNS parity requirement clear on how Custom Domain records on `www` and the apex are treated while baseline records must be DNS-only except the placeholder? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the expected setup-check state between merge and swap (item 18 failing) stated so it is not mistaken for a regression in CI or post-merge runs? [Assumption, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the requirement that the check needs no new token permission verifiable from a defined list of data sources? [Measurability, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the SC-005 contact-form confirmation (a real submission) specified as a post-swap manual step with who performs it and what outcome is accepted? [Clarity, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK023 Is SC-006 ("no DNS record outside bare and `www` changes") backed by a defined before/after comparison method? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
